svg.title: CV Protocol v5 — the run workflow
svg.desc: Workflow diagram of ROGII CV Protocol v5. Six stages: iterate freely on folds F0-F3 while F4 stays sealed; freeze one pipeline and checksum it; train 10 excluded-pair models that choose each outer fold's recipe plus 5 outer models that predict their held fold; open all five folds once in a joint reveal; Accept, Hold or Reject; package and let the user approve, which makes the solution the next run's frozen parent.
svg.text: CV Protocol v5 — how one research run works
Iterate without limit on F0–F3; measure once on all five folds; only a human moves the baseline.
Repeat as long as compute lasts.
Nothing here is reported as a result.
each trained without two folds; they choose
the recipe for the outer folds they exclude
each trained on four folds, predicting the fifth once
All five folds at the same
the user reviews CV vs LB
the approved solution becomes the next run's frozen parent
estimated only inside that fold's four-fold pool, under three
groupings; median, rounded down to the preregistered grid
the 5 outer checkpoints only — the 10 pair models never ship,
a zero-weight file may be omitted, and there is no full-data refit
each generation a correction applied to the one before it — v20 itself is never retrained
11 residual nets on cached v20 components
6 batches maximum · 5 candidate families per batch
1 joint reveal per batch — 5 spent, 1 remaining
Source: COOKBOOK.md and limited_query_cv/CV_PROTOCOL_V5.md, CV Protocol v5 revision 14 · counts from cv_query_ledger_v5.json at snapshot commit c34b9212
